<thought>The base peak at m/z 180.0423 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral mass of ~179.035 Da. An exact‑mass search shows that the formula C₉H₇O₄ has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 179.034435 Da, which matches the neutral mass within ~0.0005 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈10 % M+1) is consistent with nine carbon atoms. Therefore the molecular formula of the molecule in the sample is C9H7O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H7O4</final_answer>
